description: License exceptions for Retenia dependencies. Add entries to "exceptions" as "<package-name>": "<reason; link to the decision if applicable>" (a trailing "*" covers a family of platform-specific packages that share one license decision) for packages whose license is acceptable but does not fit the allowlist in check-licenses.mjs.

exceptions.@csstools/color-helpers: MIT-0 (MIT with the attribution clause removed) — strictly more permissive than MIT; transitive dep of Tailwind 4/lightningcss.
exceptions.@csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree: MIT-0 (MIT with the attribution clause removed) — strictly more permissive than MIT; transitive dep of Tailwind 4/lightningcss.
exceptions.@img/sharp-libvips-*: LGPL-3.0-or-later — libvips, shipped as an unmodified prebuilt shared library that sharp loads dynamically, which is the arrangement LGPL §4 exists for; we neither modify it nor link it statically. It arrives as a transitive dependency of @huggingface/transformers (packages/ingest, sub-phase 6.3), whose image pipelines Retenia never uses — we embed and rerank text only — so it is dead weight in the installer rather than a component of the app.
exceptions.@img/sharp-wasm32: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later AND MIT — the wasm fallback build of the same libvips; same reasoning as @img/sharp-libvips-*, and the same unused transitive dependency.
exceptions.caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0 — attribution-only browser support data, not code; transitive dep of browserslist (Vite/PostCSS toolchain).
exceptions.chownr: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.duck: BSD (the bundled LICENSE file is the plain two-clause BSD text, i.e. BSD-2-Clause, just not spelled as that exact SPDX id in package.json) — transitive dep of mammoth's parser-combinator library (lop), sub-phase 6.1.
exceptions.glob: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder and, at a newer version, of @storybook/react-vite (both dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.isexe: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.khroma: MIT — the LICENSE file in the package says MIT, but package.json omits the "license" field so it reads as unknown; transitive dep of mermaid.
exceptions.lru-cache: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; common transitive dep across the toolchain.
exceptions.minimatch: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.minipass: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.pako: (MIT AND Zlib) — both permissive, OSI-approved licenses; transitive dep of mammoth (via jszip) and, at an older version, of pdfkit (via fontkit, dev-only fixture-generation dependency), sub-phase 6.1.
exceptions.path-scurry: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of @storybook/react-vite (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.sax: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.tar: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.truncate-utf8-bytes: WTFPL — public-domain-equivalent, no conditions; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
exceptions.yallist: BlueOak-1.0.0 — OSI-approved permissive license; transitive dep of electron-builder (dev-only, not shipped in the app).
